concrete_issue: The live Writer identity can access the authoritative Reader endpoint, contrary to the required identity boundary.
source_evidence: Reader v1.1.2 grants access only when current_user_can('streetkingz_ai_read_product_source') is true. Writer v0.1.7 does not intentionally grant that capability.
root_cause_status: Effective live user capability or credential-to-user mapping requires audit; no production changes were made.
